Firmware experiments use dedicated boards/emulators; no flashing, deployed equipment, host policy changes or external service targeting is authorized. Crashes, undefined behavior or sanitizer reports do not establish arbitrary execution.

status.execution: Bounded fixture models actually checked separately; no new full learner/checkpoint target execution.
limitations: Accepted identities, unit bytes, descriptive historical hours and receipts are preserved.
Authored delayed opportunities are not completed assessments.
Finite passing tests do not prove absolute mastery.
